article_title: Trump says US voter fraud is 'rampant' - evidence suggests it is extremely rare

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central finding about Trump's voter-fraud claims?
options: Evidence shows postal and non-citizen voting fraud is widespread.
The available evidence indicates proven fraud is extremely rare despite Trump's claims.
No US state checks the eligibility of postal voters.
Congress has already adopted all of Trump's proposed changes.
tasks.correct_answer: The available evidence indicates proven fraud is extremely rare despite Trump's claims.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בודקת את הטענות ומראה שמחקרים ונתוני הרשעות מצביעים על מקרים נדירים מאוד.

tasks.prompt: What did the Brookings analysis find about postal-vote fraud?
options: Four cases in every thousand postal votes
About four cases for every 10 million postal votes
325 cases in each election
No postal ballots were checked
tasks.correct_answer: About four cases for every 10 million postal votes
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הניתוח של בחירות 2016–2022 מצא בממוצע כארבעה מקרי הונאה לכל עשרה מיליון קולות בדואר.

tasks.prompt: Why did the Supreme Court reject Trump's executive-order changes before the midterms?
options: The Postal Service refused to deliver any ballots.
Congress had already passed the same rules.
The Court considered changes so close to the election arbitrary and capricious.
States had abolished postal voting.
tasks.correct_answer: The Court considered changes so close to the election arbitrary and capricious.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בית המשפט קבע ששינויים כה קרובים לבחירות הם שרירותיים וחסרי הצדקה מספקת, אך השאיר אפשרות לדון בהם לאחר מכן.

tasks.prompt: In this article, what does “deterrent” mean?
options: A database used to register voters
A reward offered for reporting fraud
A document that proves citizenship
Something that discourages people from taking an action
tasks.correct_answer: Something that discourages people from taking an action
tasks.explanation_hebrew: deterrent הוא גורם מרתיע; כאן העונשים והסיכון למעמד ההגירה מרתיעים מי שאינו אזרח מהצבעה בלתי חוקית.

tasks.prompt: What concern is raised about stricter proof-of-citizenship rules?
options: About 21.3 million voting-age citizens may not have the required documents readily available.
Most non-citizens already have US passports.
States cannot verify signatures on postal ballots.
The rules would increase the number of postal votes.
tasks.correct_answer: About 21.3 million voting-age citizens may not have the required documents readily available.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החשש הוא שאזרחים זכאים רבים — כ־21.3 מיליון לפי סקר — אינם מחזיקים מסמכי הוכחת אזרחות זמינים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the Nevada example weaken confidence in using federal databases as decisive proof?
options: Nevada refused to examine the names.
The database contained no immigration records.
All 185 people labelled as non-citizens were found by state officials to be citizens.
The state discovered millions of fraudulent votes.
tasks.correct_answer: All 185 people labelled as non-citizens were found by state officials to be citizens.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המקרה מדגים שנתונים פדרליים עלולים להיות שגויים או מיושנים, ולכן אין לראות בהם הוכחה מוחלטת.

tasks.prompt: Give three pieces of evidence showing that postal-vote fraud is rare.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש ראיות מספריות או מחקריות מדויקות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Brookings found about four fraud cases per 10 million postal votes across four elections.
The Heritage database recorded 325 postal-ballot fraud convictions over 20 years.
A statistical study found no evidence that universal mail voting increased overall fraud risk.
Oregon recorded 40 fraud cases after sending more than 100 million postal ballots from 2000 to 2020.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Trump's proposed voting changes and the main evidence assessed by BBC Verify in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את ההגבלות על הצבעה בדואר, דרישות הזיהוי והאזרחות, ואת מסקנת הראיות לגבי שכיחות ההונאה.
expected_points: Trump sought to restrict postal voting and standardise ballot delivery or envelopes.
His proposed law would require photo ID, proof of citizenship at registration and continuing checks.
Studies and conviction databases show postal and non-citizen voting fraud is extremely rare.
Critics warn strict documentation rules or unreliable databases could wrongly affect eligible citizens.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate the benefits and risks of using the SAVE database to clean voter rolls. Use at least three article details.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרון אפשרי לצד סיכונים, ולהשתמש בלפחות שלוש ראיות מדויקות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Federal data can help states identify records that need review and share information.
The database was designed for benefits eligibility, not originally for voter-roll removal.
Its information may be outdated and may include people who later became citizens.
Nevada found all 185 names supplied as non-citizens were actually citizens.
Georgia identified only 432 possible non-citizens across 30 years.
The best use requires understanding limitations and verifying matches before removal.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise fact-check of the claim that non-citizen voting is “rampant”. Distinguish claims, evidence and uncertainty.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להפריד בין טענת טראמפ לבין הראיות, לציין נתונים אמינים ולהכיר במקרים קיימים אך נדירים.
expected_points: States that Trump alleges widespread non-citizen voting.
Notes that voting by non-citizens is illegal and carries serious penalties.
Cites the Heritage total of 24 convictions from 2005–2025 or the Reuters finding of 73 convictions over 30 years.
Explains that proven cases exist but are too few to support the word “rampant”.
May note data limitations or isolated registration errors without treating registration as proof of voting.
